listing.name: Blueprintify
listing.summary: Automatically generates ship blueprints for hulls that lack them, ensuring salvagers and engineers can acquire and build ships from other mods.
listing.aiSummary: Automatically generates ship blueprints for hulls that lack them, ensuring salvagers and engineers can acquire and build ships from other mods.

description:
Blueprintify

Because every ship deserves a chance to be reproduced.

Download

Requires

LunaLib

Ever install a mod full of cool ships, only to find none of them ever show up as blueprints? Your salvagers scour the sector and come up empty-handed. Your engineers stare blankly at hulls they'll never get to build. Blueprintify fixes that.

This mod automatically generates ship blueprints for any hull that doesn't already have one defined in the data folder — filling the gaps left behind by mods that don't bother wiring their ships into the blueprint system.

Modes

Cleanup Mode

(Default)

The sensible option. Blueprintify scans for ships from mods that haven't been properly assigned to a faction blueprint pool and quietly fills in the blanks. It's smart about what it picks up — only actual ship hulls make the cut. Stations, modules, drone hulls, and fighter frames are all filtered out and left alone.

Fighter wing and weapon blueprints follow the same filtering logic, so you won't end up with a cluttered, nonsensical loot table.

Full Mode

For those who want everything. Any ship hull you acquire goes into the blueprint loot pool, gated appropriately so it doesn't flood your early game. Fighter wings and weapons unlock the same way, dropping into the loot pool once you've acquired them.

Compatibility

SpoilerWorks great with my other mod

Truerecovery

As any ship acquired via this mod will also get a blueprint put in the loot pool.

When used in conjunction with

Industrial Evolution

allows any acquired ship to also be reverse engineered into a blueprint (this was actually unintentional... i just figured out that it works while testing it.)

[close]There is a debug menu in the intel ui screen, if any blueprints are missing that should be there or if any are there that should not be, let me know and let me know which section they are in.

Made by Zman147.

Started as a QOL mod but then i decided to also add the Full mode. To all modders, please make sure your ships actually show up where they're supposed to, but if they don't... this mod will pick up the pieces.

If there are any issues, whether it be with blueprints showing up where they shouldn't, other bugs, or clarification on anything, let me know.
